Paradise Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:14pm

Ingredients




1 pkt Yellow cake mix
1 pkt Vanilla pudding instant
20 ounces Crushed pineapple, undrained
5 Bananas
2 cups Pecans, chopped
1 lrg Cool Whip

Preparation

1 Bake yellow cake mix according to package directions in a 9x13" pan. When baked, pour pineapple over cake. Slice bananas and place evenly over cake. 2 Mix pudding and pour over cake and fruit. Top pudding with chopped nuts. 3 Cover all with Cool Whip. Garnish with more chopped nuts and cherries.
